command: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx playwright test dashboard.spec.ts --grep-invert '^LIVE'

failures.test: server-confirmed clock and selected trends stay live; only explicit review pins them
failures.failure: Connection label stayed Stale / projection unavailable after network restoration.
failures.resolution_under_test: A successful coherent projection restores Connected only when the actual EventSource is OPEN.

failures.test: monitoring controls and manual instruments fit a narrow viewport
failures.failure: An unfinished fault-injection route from the preceding test rejected during teardown.
failures.resolution_under_test: Wait for in-flight route handlers before changing routes or ending the injecting test.

limitations: Initial development run, not the final qualification.
Raw browser error output is not published because it included an authenticated local session cookie.

first_recheck.failure: Changing fault-injection routes briefly allowed an unmodified projection to race the second injected state.
first_recheck.resolution_under_test: Keep one route installed for both injected states; drain it only at final teardown.

first_hosted_dashboard_attempt.failure: Selected pressure chart never displayed anomaly points during accelerated streaming under concurrent load.
first_hosted_dashboard_attempt.root_cause: New hops superseded every in-flight sensor read, discarding its result and repeatedly clearing the chart.
first_hosted_dashboard_attempt.resolution_under_test: Single-flight, latest-coalesced sensor reads; atomically advance the visible map, alarm list and trend only after scoped observations arrive. The numerical warning remains independently current.
first_hosted_dashboard_attempt.note: The original hosted attempt artifact and its actual automatic tasks are retained separately, not relabeled as a successful journey.

second_hosted_dashboard_attempt.failure: The separate Playwright API observer failed with read ECONNRESET during a projection GET.
second_hosted_dashboard_attempt.service_health_after_failure: Numerical monitor and agent worker both running; the original automatic tasks continued.
second_hosted_dashboard_attempt.resolution_under_test: Permit at most two Playwright transport retries for ECONNRESET on idempotent observation GETs only. No inference retry, budget change or provider-timeout increase.
second_hosted_dashboard_attempt.credential_handling: The local session-cookie line is redacted from the retained failure XML.

third_hosted_dashboard_attempt.failure: The aggregate observer timed out after 300s waiting for the latest accepted report.
third_hosted_dashboard_attempt.root_cause: An unresolved source-95 root occupied the serial worker for 222.592025s before budget-blocked withholding. The newer source-115 root then succeeded in 120.252964s.
third_hosted_dashboard_attempt.resolution_under_test: Gather first unresolved-only context for at most one source window, immediately bypassing this hold for a qualifying leak, instrumentation issue or lost coverage. Do not start a new full report solely for NORMAL/DEGRADED changes when the physical decision remains unchanged.
third_hosted_dashboard_attempt.safety_boundary: Numerical warnings and manual inspection remain immediate. No inference retry, raised timeout, relaxed critic or silent task rebase.
